description.value:
Frequency once per day

Cost 6 Vitae

Range 30 feet

Area 30-foot burst

Saving Throw basic Reflex

Everything you were carrying, and then a piece you were not carrying.

Cut and throw a Graft of a Mark above your own capacity. It deals 16d6 damage of a type you choose. Creatures that critically fail are sickened 3 and take persistent damage of the same type equal to your level. You are drained 1 until you next rest.

cinderfall.incomplete: The real feature lets the player choose the damage type at time of use; Foundry can only store one, so the inline token defaults to force -- adjust manually at the table if a different type is chosen. The persistent damage on a critical failure (equal to your level, same type) also isn't encoded: it scales dynamically with character level, which a fixed @Damage token can't represent.
